description: A picture of the chart the signed-in member has open right now in Vela, our next-generation charting platform, in their browser, as they see it, with the market, timeframe and indicators in words and a Vela link (chart_url). Use it when the member asks about the chart they have open in Vela ("look at my chart", "what do you see here?"). To show a market inside the chat instead, use chart_open. Works for crypto charts fed by an exchange only (Binance, Binance.US, Coinbase, Hyperliquid); for any other market it says so and sends no picture. The member's Vela tab must be open and visible; a first ask after a quiet spell can say no chart is open, and asking again a minute later works. The result carries no prices beyond what the picture shows. chart_index picks one chart of a multi-chart layout (0 is the first); without it, the chart the member is working on. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

chart_index.description: One chart of a multi-chart layout, in layout order (0 is the first). Leave it out for the chart the member is working on.
